utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I’m still not totally sure on the exact issue, but I can check and get back to you. The repair drive is headed to the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That works—Sunday at the community center is good for me. Let me know what you find, and I can help once you know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks—what still needs doing for the repair drive at the community center on Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m still waiting on the exact list, but I can check and let you know. For now, I’m ready to help at the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Faye—that’ll help a lot. I’m pulling together the remaining tasks and I’ll send you the short list soon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good—send it when you can, and I’ll work it around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m checking our supplies now, and I’ll tell you the top repair-drive priorities soon.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, Cleo — I can bring tape, screws, and a sturdy hammer. Just tell me where to drop them off.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey, sorry I’m late — did I miss the repair drive details?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Not yet — I don’t have the exact details, but I can check and let you know. I do know the repair drive is headed to the community center.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, Saturday morning at the community center on Oak Street first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, great — thanks for the update. I’ll spread the word and keep an ear out for what’s needed most.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. I’m still checking what we’re short on, and I’ll pass along the top priorities soon.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — just send the first location when you have it, and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help with that, but I’d like to keep it organized — do we know what’s most urgently needed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Pia — let’s start with the most urgent repairs and I’ll spread the word to gather a few more neighbors. If you share the time and place, I’ll help rally everyone fast.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Just let me know the time and place, and I’ll spread the word and bring a few tools and supplies if I have them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on for today — I’ll send you the time and place in just a minute. Thanks for helping spread the word!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’m in, but I still need the exact issue and where the repair drive is headed. Tell me when and where, and I’ll help out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, thanks for keeping track, Mara. I still need the exact when and where for the repair drive—where should we start?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes — when and where is it happening? I can help out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what still needs doing and where the repair drive is headed? I want to make sure I have the details right before I help out.
